subproblem.title: One blow-up of a represented cycle: boundary, mass measure, concentration and Hausdorff representation
subproblem.statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, n := d + 1, Hⁿ = μHE[n], a ∈ ℝ^P, λ > 0, D := dilation a λ (y ↦ −λ⁻¹a + λ⁻¹y) and μ' := ofReal(λ^{−n})·D_#μ (ENNReal.ofReal(λ⁻¹ ^ n) • Measure.map D μ). Let Γ, Γ' ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n), μ a measure on ℝ^P, M ⊆ ℝ^P Borel, θ : ℝ^P → ℝ Borel and ζ : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) strongly measurable, such that ∂Γ = 0, μ(ℝ^P) < ∞, M_W(Γ) = μ(W) for every open W, μ = (Hⁿ⌞M) with density ofReal∘θ, θ > 0 on M, Γ(ω) = ∫_M θ(x)ζ(x)(ω(x)) dHⁿ(x) for every test n-form ω, and (h2) ∂Γ'(ω) = λ^{−d}·∂Γ(ω') for all test d-forms ω, ω' with ω'(y) = ω(D(y)) for all y; (h4) if Γ(ω) = ∫ ζ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) for all test n-forms ω, then Γ'(ω) = ∫ ζ(a + λy)(ω(y)) dμ'(y) for all ω; (h5) M_{D(W)}(Γ') = ofReal(λ^{−n})·M_W(Γ) for every W ⊆ ℝ^P. Then (P0) Γ(ω) = ∫ ζ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) for all ω; (P7) ∂Γ' = 0; (P1) μ'(K) < ∞ for every compact K; (P2) M_W(Γ') = μ'(W) for every open W; (P3) y ↦ ζ(a + λy) is μ'-a.e. strongly measurable; (P5) Γ'(ω) = ∫ ζ(a + λy)(ω(y)) dμ'(y) for all ω; (P6) μ'(ℝ^P ∖ blowUpMap a λ '' M) = 0; (P8) Γ'(ω) = ∫_{blowUpMap a λ '' M} (θ(a + λy)·ζ(a + λy))(ω(y)) dHⁿ(y) for all ω.

subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 2 (blow-ups) of the parent proof for one scale λ, together with the identity Γ(ω) = ∫ζ(ω)dμ of its step 0. The hypotheses (h2), (h4), (h5) are parts (2), (4), (5) of the parent's sibling dilation_calculus specialized to X := Γ, X' := Γ'; the parent supplies them, so they are simply hypotheses here.
Notation: η := blowUpMap a λ, c := ofReal(λ^{−n}) = ENNReal.ofReal(λ⁻¹ ^ n), so μ' = c·D_#μ; ω̂ denotes the underlying form of a test form ω.
1. (The map and the rescaled mass measure.) η = D as functions (unfold blowUpMap, dilation, dilationCLM; smul_sub; abel). D is the homeomorphism e := (y ↦ λ⁻¹y) followed by (z ↦ −λ⁻¹a + z) (Homeomorph.smulOfNeZero, Homeomorph.addLeft), so D is a measurable embedding, surjective and injective, and a + λ·D(x) = x for every x. By the sibling blowup_measure (cbr_ci_bl_blowUp_restrict_scaling) applied to M, θ, a, λ: η(M) is Borel, and (part (iii), after rewriting μ by its hypothesis) μ' = c·D_#((Hⁿ⌞M) with density ofReal∘θ) = (Hⁿ⌞η(M)) with density y ↦ ofReal θ(a + λy).
2. (P0.) For a test n-form ω: since x ↦ ofReal θ(x) is measurable and finite, ∫ ζ(x)(ω̂(x)) dμ = ∫ (ofReal θ(x)).toReal·ζ(x)(ω̂(x)) d(Hⁿ⌞M) (integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul). For x ∈ M, θ(x) > 0, so (ofReal θ(x)).toReal = θ(x) (ENNReal.toReal_ofReal); as M is Borel, setIntegral_congr_fun turns the last integral into ∫_M θ(x)·ζ(x)(ω̂(x)) dHⁿ, which equals Γ(ω) by hypothesis.
3. (P7.) Let ω be a test d-form and ω' := ω̂∘D. ω' is smooth, because ω̂ is smooth and D = (constant) + dilationCLM P λ is C^∞ (ContDiff.comp, contDiff_const.add, ContinuousLinearMap.contDiff), and it has compact support (HasCompactSupport.comp_homeomorph with e, since e = D); trivially tsupport ω' ⊆ ℝ^P. So ω' is a test d-form with ω'(y) = ω̂(D(y)) for all y, and (h2) gives ∂Γ'(ω) = λ^{−d}·∂Γ(ω') = λ^{−d}·0 = 0. Hence ∂Γ' = 0 (GeometricCurrentOn.ext, GeometricCurrentOn.zero_apply).
4. (P1.) For every K: μ'(K) = c·μ(D⁻¹K) (Measure.smul_apply, MeasurableEmbedding.map_apply) ≤ c·μ(ℝ^P) < ∞, as c < ∞ and μ(ℝ^P) < ∞ (ENNReal.mul_lt_top).
5. (P2.) Let W be open. W₀ := D⁻¹(W) is open (D is continuous) and D(W₀) = W (Set.image_preimage_eq, D surjective). By (h5) and the mass hypothesis for Γ: M_W(Γ') = M_{D(W₀)}(Γ') = c·M_{W₀}(Γ) = c·μ(W₀) = c·μ(D⁻¹W) = μ'(W) (Measure.smul_apply, MeasurableEmbedding.map_apply).
6. (P3.) y ↦ a + λy is measurable, so y ↦ ζ(a + λy) is strongly measurable (StronglyMeasurable.comp_measurable), hence μ'-a.e. strongly measurable.
7. (P5.) Apply (h4) to (P0).
8. (P6.) μ'(η(M)ᶜ) = c·μ(D⁻¹(η(M)ᶜ)) (MeasurableEmbedding.map_apply), and D⁻¹(η(M)ᶜ) = (D⁻¹(D(M)))ᶜ = Mᶜ (Set.preimage_compl, η = D, Function.Injective.preimage_image). Further μ(Mᶜ) = ∫⁻_{Mᶜ} ofReal θ d(Hⁿ⌞M) (withDensity_apply, Mᶜ Borel) = 0, because (Hⁿ⌞M)⌞Mᶜ = Hⁿ⌞(Mᶜ ∩ M) = Hⁿ⌞∅ = 0 (Measure.restrict_restrict, compl_inter_self, Measure.restrict_empty, lintegral_zero_measure). So μ'(η(M)ᶜ) = c·0 = 0.
9. (P8.) By (P5) and step 1, Γ'(ω) = ∫ ζ(a + λy)(ω̂(y)) d((Hⁿ⌞η(M)) with density ofReal θ(a + λ·)) = ∫_{η(M)} (ofReal θ(a + λy)).toReal·ζ(a + λy)(ω̂(y)) dHⁿ(y) (integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul; y ↦ ofReal θ(a + λy) is measurable and finite). For y ∈ η(M), y = η(x) with x ∈ M, and a + λy = a + λD(x) = x, so (ofReal θ(a + λy)).toReal = θ(x) = θ(a + λy) and the integrand equals (θ(a + λy)·ζ(a + λy))(ω̂(y)) (ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul). Since η(M) is Borel, setIntegral_congr_fun yields (P8). ∎
proof_key_steps: dilation a λ = blowUpMap a λ is a homeomorphism with inverse y ↦ a + λy; blowup_measure gives ofReal(λ^{−n})·D_#μ = (Hⁿ⌞η(M)) with density θ(a + λ·).
Γ(ω) = ∫ζ(ω)dμ (withDensity and θ > 0 on M); then (h4) gives the representation of Γ'.
∂Γ' = 0 from (h2) applied to the pulled-back test form ω∘D.
Mass identity on open W from (h5) with W₀ = D⁻¹W; finiteness from μ(ℝ^P) < ∞; concentration on η(M) from μ(Mᶜ) = 0.
Rewrite the representation through the withDensity identity to get Γ'(ω) = ∫_{η(M)} θ(a + λy)ζ(a + λy)(ω(y)) dHⁿ.
